verses.sloka: ऋषेर्वचनमाज्ञाय रामः सन्ध्यामुपासितुम् ।उपाक्रमत्सरः पुण्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम् ।। ७.८२.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣervacanamājñāya rāmaḥ sandhyāmupāsitum ।upākramatsaraḥ puṇyamapsarogaṇasevitam ।। 7.82.1 ॥

translations.english: Having understood the sage's words, Rama approached a sacred lake, frequented by groups of Apsaras, to perform his twilight prayers.

verses.sloka: तत्रोदकमुपस्पृश्य सन्ध्यामन्वास्य पश्चिमाम् ।आश्रमं प्राविशद्रामः कुम्भयोनेर्महात्मनः ।। ७.८२.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatrodakamupaspṛśya sandhyāmanvāsya paścimām ।āśramaṁ prāviśadrāmaḥ kumbhayonermahātmanaḥ ।। 7.82.2 ॥

translations.english: There, having performed ablutions and completed the evening twilight prayers, Rama entered the hermitage of the great-souled Agastya.

verses.sloka: तस्यागस्त्यो बहुगुणं कन्दमूलं तथौषधिम् ।शाल्यादीनि पवित्राणि भोजनार्थमकल्पयत् ।। ७.८२.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāgastyo bahuguṇaṁ kandamūlaṁ tathauṣadhim ।śālyādīni pavitrāṇi bhojanārthamakalpayat ।। 7.82.3 ॥

translations.english: For Rama, Agastya arranged a meal consisting of excellent roots, fruits, herbs, and pure rice and other grains.
translations.hindi: भूतबिनाशिनीं- बालग्रदविनाशिनौं । ( गोऽ ) & पाठान्तरे“ उपाविशत्‌ ! ? अर < $ भगवन्‌ ! श्रीरामपत्नी सीता जी के दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए हैं । हे महातेजस्वी ! सो आप चल कर, बाल-प्रह-नाशिनी-रक्षा कीजिए

verses.sloka: स भुक्तवान्नरश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम् ।प्रीतश्च परितुष्टश्च तां रात्रिं समुपाविशत् ।। ७.८२.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa bhuktavānnaraśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam ।prītaśca parituṣṭaśca tāṁ rātriṁ samupāviśat ।। 7.82.4 ॥

translations.english: The best among men, Rama, ate that nectar-like food, and being pleased and fully satisfied, he rested for that night.
translations.hindi: उनके वचन सुनते ही बाल्मीकि जी वहाँ गए, जहाँ वे दोनों बालचन्द्र के समान कान्तिमान पराक्रमी राजपुत्र थे

verses.sloka: प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय कृत्वा ऽ ऽह्निकमरिन्दमः ।ऋषिं समुपचक्राम गमनाय रघूत्तमः ।। ७.८२.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhāte kālyamutthāya kṛtvā ' 'hnikamarindamaḥ ।ṛṣiṁ samupacakrāma gamanāya raghūttamaḥ ।। 7.82.5 ॥

translations.english: In the morning, having risen and performed his daily rituals, Rama, the subduer of enemies and best of the Raghu dynasty, approached the sage for his departure.
translations.hindi: और उनमें जो पीछे हुआ था, उसका माजेन कुश की जड़ (लव ) से किआ गया था, अतः उसका नाम लव हुआ । वहाँ \ रहने बाली पत्रित्र वृद्धा तापसियों ने मुनि के हाथ से कुश ले कर, यथोचित विधि से बालकों का मार्जन कर दिझा

verses.sloka: अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्रामो महर्षिं कुम्भसम्भवम् ।आपृच्छे स्वां पुरीं गन्तुं मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। ७.८२.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādyābravīdrāmo maharṣiṁ kumbhasambhavam ।āpṛcche svāṁ purīṁ gantuṁ māmanujñātumarhasi ।। 7.82.6 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the great sage Agastya, Rama spoke, saying, "I ask your leave to go to my own city, and you ought to permit me."
translations.hindi: वहाँ जाकर और उन दोनों राजकुमारों को देख, महर्षि- वाल्मीकि जी प्रसन्न हुए र इनकी भूतघ्नी एवं रक्षोविनाशिनी रक्षा मंत्रों को पढ़ कर, की ॥॥ कुशमुष्टिमुपादाय लव चेव तु स द्विजः । वारमीकिः प्रददौ ताभ्यां रक्षां भूतविनाशिनीम्‌

verses.sloka: धन्यो ऽस्म्यनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि दर्शनेन महात्मनः ।द्रष्टुं चैवागमिष्यामि पावनार्थमिहात्मनः ।। ७.८२.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi darśanena mahātmanaḥ ।draṣṭuṁ caivāgamiṣyāmi pāvanārthamihātmanaḥ ।। 7.82.7 ॥

translations.english: I am blessed and favored by the sight of your great self, and I shall indeed come here again to see you for the purification of my own soul.
translations.hindi: संत्र पढ़ कर कुश से उनका मार्जन किआ गया था, अतएव उनमें से पूर्वेउत्पन्न बालक का नाम कुश

verses.sloka: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः ।। ७.८२.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathā vadati kākutsthe vākyamadbhutadarśanam ।uvāca paramaprīto dharmanetrastapodhanaḥ ।। 7.82.8 ॥

translations.english: As Rama, whose words were of wonderful meaning, spoke thus, the sage Agastya, whose vision was righteousness and whose wealth was austerity, spoke, being extremely pleased.

verses.sloka: अत्यद्भुतमिदं वाक्यं तव राम शुभाक्षरम् ।पावनः सर्वभूतानां त्वमेव रघुनन्दन ।। ७.८२.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: atyadbhutamidaṁ vākyaṁ tava rāma śubhākṣaram ।pāvanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ tvameva raghunandana ।। 7.82.9 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, your words are indeed very wonderful and auspicious, for you alone, O delight of the Raghus, are the purifier of all beings.

verses.sloka: मुहूर्तमपि राम त्वां ये च पश्यन्ति केचन ।पाविताः स्वर्गभूताश्च पूज्यास्ते सर्वदैवतैः ।। ७.८२.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: muhūrtamapi rāma tvāṁ ye ca paśyanti kecana ।pāvitāḥ svargabhūtāśca pūjyāste sarvadaivataiḥ ।। 7.82.10 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, even those who merely see you for a moment become purified and attain heaven, and they are then worshipable by all deities.

verses.sloka: ये च त्वां घोरचक्षुर्भिः पश्यन्ति प्राणिनो भुवि ।हतास्ते यमदण्डेन सद्यो निरयगामिनः ।। ७.८२.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye ca tvāṁ ghoracakṣurbhiḥ paśyanti prāṇino bhuvi ।hatāste yamadaṇḍena sadyo nirayagāminaḥ ।। 7.82.11 ॥

translations.english: Those living beings on earth who look at you with hostile eyes are immediately struck down by the rod of Yama and go to hell.

verses.sloka: ईदृशस्त्वं रघुश्रेष्ठ पावनः सर्वदेहिनाम् ।भुवि त्वां कथयन्तो ऽपि सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति राघव ।। ७.८२.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśastvaṁ raghuśreṣṭha pāvanaḥ sarvadehinām ।bhuvi tvāṁ kathayanto 'pi siddhimeṣyanti rāghava ।। 7.82.12 ॥

translations.english: O best of Raghus, you are such a purifier of all embodied beings, and even those on earth who merely speak of you, O scion of Raghu, will attain perfection.
translations.hindi: आधी रात के समय शत्रुघ्न जो ने यह शुभसंबाद सुना और . ! वे सीता देवी की पणंशाला में जा बाले कि, यह बड़े र डे ही सोभाग्य की बात हे कि, जो तुम्हा रे पुत्र हुए हैं

verses.sloka: गच्छ चारिष्टमव्याग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम् ।प्रशाधि राज्यं धर्मेण गतिर्हि जगतो भवान् ।। ७.८२.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaccha cāriṣṭamavyāgraḥ panthānamakutobhayam ।praśādhi rājyaṁ dharmeṇa gatirhi jagato bhavān ।। 7.82.13 ॥

translations.english: Go forth calmly on an auspicious and fearless path, and rule your kingdom with righteousness, for you are indeed the support of the world.
translations.hindi: शत्रुघ्न की वह सावन मास की रात, इस प्रकार आनन्द मनाते हुए बड़ी जल्दी बीत गई

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना प्राञ्जलिः प्रग्रहो नृपः ।अभ्यवादयत प्राज्ञस्तमृषिं पुण्यशालिनम् ।। ७.८२.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu muninā prāñjaliḥ pragraho nṛpaḥ ।abhyavādayata prājñastamṛṣiṁ puṇyaśālinam ।। 7.82.14 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by the sage, the wise and humble king, with folded hands, saluted that virtuous sage.
translations.hindi: प्रातःकाल होते ही सबेरे के कृत्यो से निश्चित हो और मुनि को प्रणाम कर और उनसे आज्ञा ले, वे महावीर शत्रुघ्न जी पश्चिमदिशा की ओर चल दिए

verses.sloka: अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तांश्च सर्वांस्तपोधनान् ।अध्यारोहत्तदव्यग्रः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् ।। ७.८२.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṁ tāṁśca sarvāṁstapodhanān ।adhyārohattadavyagraḥ puṣpakaṁ hemabhūṣitam ।। 7.82.15 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the best of sages and all those ascetics, he then calmly ascended the Pushpaka chariot, which was adorned with gold.

verses.sloka: तं प्रयान्तं मुनिगणा ह्याशीर्वादैः समन्ततः ।अपूजयन्महेन्द्राभं सहस्राक्षमिवामराः ।। ७.८२.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ prayāntaṁ munigaṇā hyāśīrvādaiḥ samantataḥ ।apūjayanmahendrābhaṁ sahasrākṣamivāmarāḥ ।। 7.82.16 ॥

translations.english: As Rama departed, groups of sages honored him from all sides with blessings, just as the gods worship Indra, who resembles Mahendra and has a thousand eyes.
translations.hindi: महायशस्बी शत्रुघ्न जी भ्रगुवंशी च्यवनादि महर्विर्यो से अनेक सुन्दर कथाएँ सुनते हुए, वहाँ रहे

verses.sloka: स्वस्थः स ददृशे रामः पुष्पके हेमभूषिते ।शशी मेघसमीपस्थो यथा जलधरागमे ।। ७.८२.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: svasthaḥ sa dadṛśe rāmaḥ puṣpake hemabhūṣite ।śaśī meghasamīpastho yathā jaladharāgame ।। 7.82.17 ॥

translations.english: Rama, at ease in the gold-adorned Pushpaka, appeared like the moon near a cloud at the onset of the monsoon season.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते पूज्यमानस्ततस्ततः ।अयोध्यां प्राप्य काकुत्स्थो मध्यकक्ष्यामवारुहत् ।। ७.८२.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato 'rdhadivase prāpte pūjyamānastatastataḥ ।ayodhyāṁ prāpya kākutstho madhyakakṣyāmavāruhat ।। 7.82.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, by midday, Rama, being honored from all sides, reached Ayodhya and descended into the middle chamber of his palace.

verses.sloka: ततो विसृज्य रुचिरं पुष्पकं कामगामि तत् ।विसर्जयित्वा गच्छेति स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्विति च प्रभुः ।। ७.८२.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato visṛjya ruciraṁ puṣpakaṁ kāmagāmi tat ।visarjayitvā gaccheti svasti te 'stviti ca prabhuḥ ।। 7.82.19 ॥

translations.english: Then, the lord Rama dismissed that beautiful Pushpaka, which moved at will, saying "Go, and let there be welfare for you."

verses.sloka: कक्षान्तरविनिक्षिप्तं द्वास्स्थं रामो ऽब्रवीद्वचः ।लक्ष्मणं भरतं चैव गत्वा तौ लघुविक्रमौ ।ममागमनमाख्याय शब्दापयत मा चिरम् ।। ७.८२.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: kakṣāntaravinikṣiptaṁ dvāssthaṁ rāmo 'bravīdvacaḥ ।lakṣmaṇaṁ bharataṁ caiva gatvā tau laghuvikramau ।mamāgamanamākhyāya śabdāpayata mā ciram ।। 7.82.20 ।।

translations.english: Rama then spoke to the doorkeeper, who was stationed in an inner chamber, instructing him to swiftly go and inform Lakshmana and Bharata of his arrival, and to summon them without delay. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे व्द्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 82 ।। Thus ends the eighty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
